title: Office Space Utilisation from Sensors

blueprintSignals.name: Peak occupancy
blueprintSignals.definition: 95th percentile of hourly counts per zone over four weeks
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Sensor errors create spikes, so remove impossible values

blueprintSignals.name: Booked vs used
blueprintSignals.definition: booked hours with no detected occupancy divided by booked hours

blueprintSignals.name: Dwell time
blueprintSignals.definition: median minutes people stay in a zone
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Sensors miss still people, so cross-check with a second source

blueprintSignals.name: Day pattern
blueprintSignals.definition: weekday profile of mean occupancy across weeks
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Patterns shift with policies, so refresh it often

engineFeatures.meaning: mean of the last 7 and 28 days and their ratio, known at the forecast origin
values on the same weekday in previous weeks
what is already booked or ordered for the target day at the origin
promotion and external-signal flags for the target day, as published at the origin
how many of the recent days are missing in the feed

label: For "Office Space Utilisation from Sensors": Measure how workspaces and meeting rooms are actually used from sensors and badge data to right-size the portfolio and plan layouts. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: A short pilot period misses seasonal peaks and holidays.
